summary: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd, an Australian pharmaceutical development-stage company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 17, 2026, covering the month of June 2026. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, providing notice of a change of director's interest. The only exhibits submitted are Change of Director's Interest Notices; no transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. As a non-US filing, this Form 6-K is equivalent to a domestic current report on Form 8-K for director-related changes. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situations event.
